source: PY2026 Machine-Readable URL PUF (346 issuer rows, 108 unique index URLs) + 108 index probes + 162 sampled provider files

totals.note_file_counts: file counts include deep-probe fallbacks for indexes that 403d the plain probe (UHC, Wellmark, MercyCare); slight variance vs the 4,337 headline is expected. Humana alone is 2,995 (dental/pharmacy) files.
totals.note_size: estimate = per-index mean sampled size x provider file count; samples Range-capped (8MB most, 30MB UHC, 200MB some), so lower bound AND biased by which files were sampled -- treat as order of magnitude only

dental_medical_method: classified per hosting platform using specialty vocabularies in sampled files + issuer identity (POC email domain, brand). Caveats: EMI Health and Humana classified dental from FFM market presence; BCBSM MI dental-heavy sample reflects Range sampling from file start of a mixed network file, both MI rows kept medical.
